projectDescription: A Python library for creating, reading, and manipulating Research Object Crates (RO-Crates) — a standards-based format for packaging research data with rich JSON-LD metadata.
keyFeatures: Create RO-Crates programmatically with files, datasets, and rich JSON-LD metadata
Read and consume existing RO-Crates from directories, zip archives, URLs, or dict objects
Support for RO-Crate specifications 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2 (including detached crates in 1.2)
Workflow RO-Crate profile support with CWL, Galaxy, Nextflow, Snakemake, KNIME, COMPSs, and Autosubmit
Nested/subcrate support for hierarchical crate structures (RO-Crate 1.2)
Streaming zip serialization for serving crates from web APIs without writing to disk
Testing metadata support via ro-terms TestSuite, TestInstance, and TestDefinition entities
Command-line interface (rocrate) for initializing crates and adding entities from the shell
JSON-LD patch API (add_jsonld, update_jsonld, add_or_update_jsonld) for modifying crates from dictionaries
Automatic percent-encoding of special characters in entity identifiers
